detail.longDescription: 🚩 Microsoft Teams is a red flag ｢ When a company runs on Microsoft Teams and Outlook, I assume one thing about how it makes decisions: the tools its people spend all day in were chosen by someone who barely uses them, and whose deciding factor was a line in a licensing spreadsheet ｣ https:// blog.raed.dev/posts/microsoft- teams-red-flag/ # teams # collaboration # productivity
